FAILURE_RULES: Single bounded implementation-qualification work package/campaign; grant ends on owner revocation/supersession, campaign completion, unexpected or genuine authority/environment/permission/safety gate failure, or budget exhaustion. Manifest-sealed expected negative-case rejection may complete that case without activating forbidden operations; only the next distinct presealed case may follow, never a retry. No implicit new campaign; failures retained immutably.
FIRST_MISSING_PREREQUISITE: Full direct-host mandatory control/permission proof and sufficiently sealed actual profile
NEW_CAMPAIGN_IDENTITY_OR_DETERMINISTIC_I: Actual issued content binds current approved host/profile/executable/fixtures/oracles/output/limits and explicit owner decision; canonical subject/grant/campaign identities exclude own wrapper/future approvals. No issued identity invented here.

RESOURCE_LIMITS.EXTRA_CAMPAIGNS: Require fresh explicit bounded approval; no implicit repeat after failure/timeout/budget depletion

SOURCE_RECONCILIATION_BLOCKERS: contracts.py pins original grant/protocol digest; a fresh current authority relationship requires explicit validation, not proposed-subject/hash substitution
supervisor.py fixes source-relative stopped campaign journal; fresh journal/workspace mapping or separately authorised source amendment must preserve old bytes
